title: Mark Andrews: Lamar Jackson is evolving and getting better in "totally different" offense

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Mark Andrews: Lamar Jackson is evolving and getting better in "totally different" offense
sources.description: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson has been impressed by new offensive coordinator Declan Doyle this offseason and Jackson's immersion into Doyle's offense has impressed one of the quarterback's longtime teammates.
